title: Practice 10: в- and вы-: in, and out

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Залепив Тому пощёчину, Маша ___ (выбежать / выбегать) из комнаты.
exercises.why: **вы́бежать** — **выбега́ть** — to run out (outside). **вы́нести** — **выноси́ть** — to carry out, to take out, to bring out, to remove; to transfer. **вы́вести** — **выводи́ть** — to take out, to lead out, to bring out, to move out; to help out (help someone to get off); to withdraw, to call off (troops). **вы́везти** — **вывози́ть** — to take out (by vehicle), to remove; to deliver. **вы́лезть** — **вылеза́ть** — to get out, to climb out, to get off; (of hair) to fall out, to come out. — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: After slapping Tom, Mary ran out of the room.
exercises.context: вы́бежать** — **выбега́ть — to run out (outside).

exercises.q: Love and companionship can transcend traditional mating norms.
exercises.why: The verbs входить (to enter, to come in, to go in) and выходить (to come out, to go out) belong to the 2nd ("-и-") type of conjugation. They are conjugated exactly like the verb ходить: я вхожу, ты входишь … они входят; я выхожу, ты выходишь … они выходят. The verbs въезжать (to drive in) and выезжать (to drive out) belong to the 1st ("-е-") type of conjugation (like читать): я въезжаю, ты въезжаешь … они въезжают. Ввозить — ввезти — to haul in, to import; вывозить — вывезти — to haul out, to export. Note the special use of the verbs "ввозить" and "вывозить": Англия ввозит зерно, а вывозит машины. — England imports grain and exports machinery. Note also the nouns: ввоз — import; вывоз —… — DLI, Lesson 33.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
